mintime
An integer indicating the Unix timestamp in
seconds for the beginning of the report
period.
maxtime
An integer indicating the Unix timestamp in
seconds for the end of the report period.
user_authentication_attempts
An integer indicating the number of users
with authentication attempts during the
specified time period, broken down by
result. Refer to Authentication Attempts
Report for a list of result types and their
meanings.
